skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply advanced macroeconomic theories to evaluate the impact of events and policy changes on key macroeconomic variables.
Apply quantitative techniques to analyze macroeconomic relationships and evaluate the impact of policies or shocks on the economy.
Handle and analyze time series data, including issues of correlation over time and stability.
Use statistical software (Eviews) to analyze and model macroeconomic data.
Develop independent research skills, work in groups, and present knowledge through writing and discussion on macroeconomic issues.
Critically analyze macroeconomic issues in Vietnam and other countries.
Enhance self-learning and research skills on macroeconomic issues in practice.
Work collaboratively in groups and present findings effectively.
Effectively present research findings and engage in discussions.
